name.en: Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>魔<rt>ま</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt>じょ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>光彩<rt>ひかり</rt></ruby>

text.en:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Diabell" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using up to 1 "Winter Raven" monster each from your hand, Extra Deck, and/or field.
● If you control a "Diabell" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch" once per turn.
text.zh-CN:
此卡名的①效果1回合仅可使用1次。①：可从以下效果中选择1个发动。
●从自己手牌・墓地将1只“白鸦”怪兽特殊召唤。
●从自己手牌・额外牌组・场上各将最多1只“白鸦”怪兽作为融合素材，将1只“迪亚贝尔”融合怪兽融合召唤。
●自己场上存在“迪亚贝尔”怪兽的情况下，以场上的1张表侧表示卡为对象可以发动。将该卡的效果直至回合结束时为止无效。
